name: Jinghua Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinghua Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals in China and internationally. The company offers active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and intermediates, chemical and pharmaceutical intermediates, Chinese medicinal herbs and materials, health products, and Western medicine products.
